title: Notice regarding Sitting of Hon'ble First Court on 30.10.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Read :- Notice No. HCG-01/2026, dated 29/10/2026.
Date: - 30/10/2026

FULL TEXT:
Read :- Notice No. HCG-01/2026, dated 29/10/2026.
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 30/10/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-02/2026
In continuation of the Notice mentioned in the
Preamble, It is hereby notified that after completion of
matters at Sr. No. 2 and Sr. No. 12 of the Notice mentioned
in the Preamble, Hon’ble the Acting Chief Justice
Mr. Justice Manash Ranjan Pathak and Hon’ble Mr. Justice
Nirzar S. Desai would sit in Regular Division Bench and
take up the matters as per the Roster.
By Order
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
